subject: Sizing next steps: deploy-mode tradeoffs and GPU profile
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Patel <samira@integros.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sizing next steps: deploy-mode tradeoffs and GPU profile

Hi Samira — thanks again for the demo and for walking us through Integro's realtime summarization use case earlier today. Quick recap and a proposed next-step list so we stay aligned on the deployment decision (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private VPC) and the sizing inputs we need for a Dedicated path.

Why Dedicated is on the table
- You mentioned predictable latency for customer-facing summarization and compliance needs for data residency; Dedicated + VPC would meet both.
- Tradeoff: Dedicated gives lower p99 latency and reserved throughput at higher commit cost vs. Hosted which is operationally simpler.

What we need from Integro to size a Dedicated pool (action items)
1) TPS targets: average and 95th percentile requests per second during peak window (estimate range is fine).
2) Token mix: average input length (tokens) and average generated length; sample payloads are most helpful.
3) Concurrency tolerance: target p95 latency we should design for (e.g., 200ms, 400ms).
4) SLO / fallback: if latency spikes, is graceful degradation acceptable (lower-quality model) or must we maintain a specific model variant?
5) Compliance constraints: confirm whether VPC-only access is required or if a dedicated instance in our hosted region with customer-managed keys suffices.

Early recommended GPU families to evaluate (we'll validate with benchmark):
- A100/80GB: best for high-throughput low-latency at longer context lengths
- H100: best absolute perf for models >70B and mixed-precision kernels
- L4/RTX-class: cost-efficient for lower token-length streams and high multiplexing

Attached: redwood_dedicated_sizing_worksheet.xlsx — please fill columns for TPS and token mix where possible. I also attached a short pricing snapshot for reference.

Proposed immediate next steps
- You: quick answers to items 1–4 + sample payloads (can be anonymized).
- Us: run a conservative sizing exercise and share a 2-option proposal (cost-first and latency-first).
- Follow-up call: 30 minutes next week to review worksheet, confirm GPU recommendation.

Thanks — Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.ai
Attachment: redwood_dedicated_sizing_worksheet.xlsx (spreadsheet), proposal_pricing_snapshot.pdf (pdf)

From: Samira Patel <samira@integros.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Cc: Integro Procurement <procurement@integros.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sizing next steps: deploy-mode tradeoffs and GPU profile

Vivek — thanks for the clear recap. Answering the checklist below (high-level for now):

1) TPS targets
- Avg TPS: 12
- Peak p95 TPS: 90 (peak windows are typically 10–15 minutes during batch run-ups)

2) Token mix
- Average input length: 400 tokens (customer messages + context)
- Average generation: 220 tokens
- We will share 20 anonymized sample payloads via the Drive link after redaction.

3) Concurrency / latency expectations
- Target p95 latency: <= 350ms for UX-critical flows; <= 800ms acceptable for background batch summarization.
- Prefer to avoid graceful degradation for customer-facing summaries.

4) Compliance
- We require VPC-only access for production and encryption with our KMS. Non-prod may use hosted with contractual controls.

Notes on models / fallbacks
- We are evaluating two model families internally: a 33B distilled LLM for summaries and a 70B open model for higher-fidelity cases. If you have latency profiles for both that'd help.

Attaching: sample_payloads_manifest.csv (will upload full set to your Drive link).

—Samira
Samira Patel
Head of Product — Ingest & Summarization, Integro Systems
samira@integros.com

Samira — perfect, this is exactly what we needed to start a concrete sizing. Quick clarifications and what we'll run next: 

Clarifications
- For the 70B model you mentioned, do you expect to serve it in 1:1 with the 33B or as on-demand fallback for only top-tier customers? That affects pool mix and kernel selection.
- Can you confirm whether the 10–15 minute peak windows are predictable (scheduled) or spontaneous? Scheduled peaks allow better packing/slotting.

What we'll do by EOD tomorrow
- Marissa will run a conservative sizing run for two pools: (A) latency-first with H100/A100 skew and (B) cost-first with L4 multiplexing.
- We'll baseline expected p95 latency for 33B vs 70B with your token shapes and provide expected token-costs per 1M requests.
- Share a short appendix on quantization/precision tradeoffs that affect memory footprint per GPU.

Attached: filled version of redwood_dedicated_sizing_worksheet.xlsx (first-pass) — see tab "estimates". We'll link the detailed benchmarks after we run the model sims.

If you prefer, we can schedule a 30-minute walkthrough tomorrow; otherwise we'll send the two-option proposal and recommended next call times.

Thanks — Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>

Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Integro sizing follow-up + ask list (do not externalize)

Marissa / Ben — internal action items based on Samira's reply (thread above):

Summary of prospect asks
- Peak p95 TPS ~90, avg 12, token mix avg_in=400 / avg_out=220.
- Production must be VPC-only and KMS controlled. Non-prod less strict.
- Two model families: 33B (primary) + 70B (fallback/on-demand). No graceful degradation for UX-critical flows.

Proposed internal plan
1) Marissa: run 2 pool sims — (A) H100-heavy latency-first for p95 <=350ms; (B) L4-multiplex cost-first for background/batch paths. Please include memory headroom for KV cache at 4k context and for 8k fallback.
2) Ben: prepare a short note on procurement lead times and whether we can support a hybrid Dedicated+Private VPC onboarding (customer-managed KMS). Confirm any additional compliance docs needed.
3) Vivek: schedule a 30-minute call with Samira next Tue (09:00 PT) to review proposal.

Risks / open questions
- If 70B is used frequently, A100/H100 becomes necessary; quantify how often to justify the uplift.
- Need to confirm if peak windows are scheduled — if not, we model for more headroom.

I'll own the first-pass sizing deliverable. Marissa — can you get the sims run by COB Monday? Ben — can you confirm compliance/lead-time by Monday as well?

Cheers — Vivek
